newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to open four stock options next week.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to open four stock options next week.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange said Thursday it will open trading in four stock options next week.
Options on shares of Dominick's Supermarkets Inc, Fairchild Corp and Wausau Paper Mills Co will open July 21. PHLX will launch options on B.A.T Industries Plc July 23.

Dominick's and Fairchild options will trade on the March cycle, with initial expiries in August, September, December and March. Fairchild options opening strikes will be 17-1/2, 20, and 22-1/2. Dominick's strikes will be 25, 30 and 35.
Options on Wausau Paper will trade on the February cycle, with initial expiries in August, September, November and February. Options strike prices will be 17-1/2, 20 and 22-1/2.
B.A.T options will trade on the January cycle, with initial expiries in August, September, October and January. Opening strike prices will be 15, 17-1/2 and 20.
PHLX set position limits at 4,500 in Dominick's, Fairchild and Wausau Paper options and at 7,500 in B.A.T options.

GPZ Trading will be specialist for Dominick's and Wausau Paper, Group One Ltd will handle Fairchild, and Susquehanna Investment Group will be specialist for B.A.T. options. ((Derivatives Desk (312) 408-8750)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
